title: Every ffmpeg/ffprobe call still pops a console window - the MPI-637 guard test cannot see a promisified call site
description: Reported 2026-08-29: ~20 terminals flashed on a normal 'npm start' boot, after MPI-637 was closed as fixed. MPI-637 added windowsHide:true to every LITERAL child_process call in routes/ and services/, and a guard test (tests/windows-hide-spawn.test.cjs) to keep it that way. The scanner matches the call by CALLEE NAME - /(spawnSync|spawn|execFileSync|execFile|execSync)\s*\(/ - so the nine sites that call the promisified alias 'execFileP(...)' are invisible to it and none of them passes windowsHide: routes/videoCrop.js:129, routes/videoGif.js:114, routes/videoReverse.js:120, routes/videoTrimInput.js:94, services/ffmpegThumb.js:48,100,156, services/ffprobeVideo.js:36,93. ffmpeg and ffprobe are console-subsystem, the forked server.js owns no console, so each call gets its own conhost. The boot burst is POST /backfill-media-derivatives, which runs on project open and shells out once per missing thumb/rendition/proxy - one flashing terminal each. Fix both halves: the flag on all nine, and a scanner that resolves promisify(execFile) aliases so the next one cannot hide the same way.
